---
name: Bug report
about: Something broke — help us reproduce it
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**What template were you using?**
Onyx / Cascade / Notebook / etc.

**What did you do?**
A short list of clicks/keystrokes. The smaller the repro, the faster the fix.

**What happened?**
Including screenshots is great if a visual thing is off.

**What did you expect?**

**Environment**
- Browser + version: (e.g. Chrome 132, Firefox 128, Safari 17)
- OS: (macOS / Windows / Linux / iOS / Android)
- Did this work on a previous version? If you know.

**Optional**
A redacted `easycv.json` export of the doc that reproduces the bug helps a lot. (Builder → ⋯ → export as → easycv json.)
